A5: Reserved (4 bits), the eight control flags CWR, ECE, URG, ACK, PSH, RST, SYN, FIN (1 bit each), and Window (16 bits) share the same word as Data Offset.

A8: The Options field is present when Data Offset > 5; since Data Offset's maximum value is 15 (60 bytes), the maximum total TCP header length is 60 bytes.
